## Automated Tests Required

All suites follow `tests/README.md` and `.claude/rules/test-standards.md`: file `[system]_[feature]_test.gd`, function `test_[scenario]_[expected]`, Arrange/Act/Assert. Gameplay numbers come from `TestConstants`, never literals (boundary-value tests and the GDD's pinned example values excepted). Use `auto_free(...)` on every Node, take doubles from `tests/helpers/`, and construct rules code directly in `tests/unit/**`, never through `Boot`. **No time-dependent assertion in any of these suites** (see Cross-cutting 4).

### MR-003 Match setup — Logic (tier full) [S, merges first in W1]
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/match_rules/match_rules_setup_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-01: two `MatchConfig`s whose `rng_match` is a fresh `stream("match_1")` from a `run_seed = 42` service → identical deck instance orders and starting hands across the two runs; `TestRngService.draws_outside(["match_1"]) == 0`.
- AC-02: at `mulligan_offered`, player hand 3, boss hand 4 (`TestConstants`), both heroes `mana 0/0`, player health 30, boss health `== MatchConfig.boss.health`, `phase == Mulligan`, `turn == 0`, `fatigue_counter == 0`, `armor == 0`. Log order via `EventLogAssertions.assert_order`: `deck_shuffled(player)`, `deck_shuffled(boss)`, [hook events], 3 × `card_drawn(player)`, 4 × `card_drawn(boss)`, `mulligan_offered`.
- AC-43: `boss.health = 42` → `max_health == 42`, whatever the boss definition's `health`. A `modify_starting_hand_size` hook returning 14 → hand exactly `HAND_SIZE`, no `card_burned` (one clamp to `[0, HAND_SIZE]`). Two installers with the same `host_id` → `hook_install_skipped{host_id, reason: duplicate}` appended by the engine, and only the first installed.
- Binding order (ADR-0007 Decision 2): `state.hooks` is constructed and `resolver.bind(...)` runs before heroes, decks and `on_match_start`. Assert through the scripted `TestEffectResolver` call log.

**Edge cases to cover** (match-rules Edge Cases → Mulligan and setup, Hand/draw/fatigue):
- A hand-size hook that changes only one side (the boss stays at 4 while the player's hook adds 1).
- A hand-size fold result below 0 clamps to 0.
- A 0-card deck at match start: starting-hand draws apply fatigue 1, 2, 3 before the mulligan, with no special case. Include it only if the fatigue primitive exists. Fatigue belongs to MR-006, so otherwise record it as not exercised.
- The resolver double keeps the engine reference as a plain field, so the later teardown test can observe `weakref.get_ref() == null` (Engine Notes).

**Estimated test count**: ~9 unit tests

### RNG-005 EventLog core — Logic [S, merges second in W1]
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/rng_event_log/event_log_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- 5 appends → `seq` 1..5; `events_since(3)` returns exactly seq 4 and 5; every subscriber receives each event once, in registration order. `EventLogAssertions.assert_envelopes_valid` holds, `type` is a `String`, and the payload is a deep copy (mutating the caller's dict after `append` leaves the stored event unchanged).
- `cause_seq = 40` → `seq > 40`, `cause_seq == 40`.
- `turn` is 0 before the first `set_turn`, then the last `set_turn` value.
- `match_ended` (scope `match`) and `run_ended` (scope `run`) each seal the log. After sealing, `append` returns `-1`, stores nothing and notifies no one; `size()` and `snapshot()` report the sealed contents.
- A subscriber that appends: in release the nested append is accepted with the next `seq` and `payload._reentrant == true`. Debug asserts, so test the release path through the non-asserting branch or `assert_failure`, as sprint 1's RNG tests did.

**Edge cases to cover** (rng-event-log Edge Cases → Events): `events_since(seq)` with `seq` ≥ the last seq → `[]`; with `seq < 0` → all events (neither is an error). The `cause_seq < seq` invariant holds on the nested chain example (40 → 44): `assert_cause_seq_valid`. No Godot signal is used for delivery (introspect the signal list: only `overflowed` is allowed, and it arrives in RNG-007).
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### CDB-002 Record schema validation — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/card_database/card_database_schema_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- One fixture set carrying every CR-3 fault from AC-1: `durabilty`; a spell with `attack`; a minion lacking `health`; a weapon lacking `durability`; `health: 0`; `cost: 11`; a keyword outside DD-M09; a repeated keyword; `spell_damage: 2` without the keyword; a bad id pattern; an id prefix that disagrees with `set`/file; a wrong `text.key`. Each must raise its code (`E_UNKNOWN_FIELD`, `E_MISSING_FIELD`, `E_SCHEMA`, `E_BAD_ENUM`, `E_SET_MISMATCH`, `E_TEXT_KEY`) naming file, record id and field, **all in one report** (no fail-fast).
- `card_database.json`: `min_bundle_pool: 2` → `E_SCHEMA` naming file and key, state `Failed`. All five knobs at their range edges (10/100, 3/30, 50/1000, 1/32) → no entry. Show that no other config body is schema-checked here.
- `unlock` shapes: a bare-string hero `unlock` → schema error naming `unlock`; the bundle object form passes stage 4; `unlock: null` bundles are clean; hero `hero_power: null` → `E_MISSING_FIELD`.
- Boss passive pairs: `passive` + `passive_text` is clean; `passive` with no text → `E_MISSING_FIELD`; `passive: null` + text → `E_UNKNOWN_FIELD`; `passive: null` + `hero_power: null` → `E_SCHEMA`. Treasure `tags` are accepted.

**Edge cases to cover** (card-database Edge Cases → Enums and shapes): `durability: 0` → `E_SCHEMA`; `cost` −1 and 0 and 10 (boundaries); integral fields arriving as JSON floats (`3.0` accepted, `3.5` rejected — Engine Notes, never `typeof == TYPE_INT`).
**File I/O note**: fixture roots under `tests/fixtures/card_database/`, injected path — the same accepted exception as CDB-001.
**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit tests

### BOOT-005 Grep gates G1–G6 and per-file parse check — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/boot/boot_lint_gates_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `tools/lint/gates.sh` (via `OS.execute`) against each deliberately broken fixture under `tests/fixtures/lint/<gate>/` (G1, G2, G2b, G3, G5, G6) → non-zero exit, output line `<gate> <file>:<line>` naming that gate; then against the real tree → exit 0.
- G2b split: `\bawait\b` under `src/gameplay/**` / `src/core/**`, deny-list form under `src/ai/**` (a plain `await` on a non-tree call in `src/ai/` must **not** hit).
- G4: exactly one `[autoload]` entry, named `Boot`; a fixture `project.godot` with two entries fails.
- G5: `MatchState|RunState` under `src/ui/**` hits; `.submit(` allowed only in `*_controller.gd`, `*_driver.gd`, `*_view.gd`.
- `rg` absent or older than 14 → exit 2 with a message (simulate by PATH override in the fixture run).
- `tools/lint/parse-check.sh`: one invocation per file over `src/gameplay/**`, `src/ai/**`, `src/core/**`; a fixture with a non-parsing script → non-zero exit / `PARSE FAIL`.
- `tests.yml`: one blocking step running both scripts after the import and before the gdUnit4 run.

**G3 and G6 patterns**: take them from ADR-0001 Decision 6 **as corrected by the code-review fix pass now in progress** (Cross-cutting 1). This plan does not restate them. The G3 fixtures must include a doc-comment line and the `class_name Services` declaration as **non-hits**. The G6 fixtures must include a legitimate stream call as a non-hit and the bare global calls the review named as hits. The real-tree run must exit 0 with the corrected patterns.
**Edge cases**: a fixture tree with no `.gd` files (exit 0, not an error). `src/gameplay/effects/` comes into existence with CE-003 (W1), so re-run the real-tree assertion after CE-003 merges.
**Environment**: the test shells out to `rg` and `godot`. CI must provide ripgrep ≥ 14 (the container has 14.1.0). If `ubuntu-latest` lacks it, the CI step installs it; otherwise both the lint step and this suite fail in CI only.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 integration tests

### BAI-002 ProfileResolver and validator — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/boss_ai/boss_ai_profile_resolver_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `resolve(config, boss_def, band)` = `default ⊕ archetype ⊕ bands[band] ⊕ boss_override`, with later sections winning shallowly per section (`weights`, `rules`, `budgets`, `intent_mode`, `choice_preference`, `synergy_tags`).
- F9 example: `boss_rot_warden` → `w_passive 2.5`, `w_self 1.5`, the band's `budgets` and `defensive`, `synergy_tags == ["deathrattle"]`.
- A25: `ai_profile = "does_not_exist"` → `E_AI_PROFILE_UNKNOWN` via the stage-7 validator; the resolver falls back to `default ⊕ bands[band]`.
- A26: `w_face = 9` → `E_AI_WEIGHT_RANGE`, effective weight 5 (clamped, never zeroed); `INF`/`NAN` → same code.
- `validate_profiles_config`: unknown field → `E_AI_UNKNOWN_FIELD`. An op with no `op_values` row → valued 1.0, `E_AI_OP_UNVALUED` **once per op type per load**. `runtime.planner_mode ∈ {worker, time_sliced, immediate}`, defaults `worker`/2/2, anything else rejected.
- The resolver does not mutate the snapshot (deep-compare the input after resolve).

**Edge cases to cover** (boss-ai Edge Cases → Data and determinism): `ai_profile` missing entirely (same as unknown); a weight exactly at each range edge (no error); int-ranged fields (`lethal_max_nodes`, `overextend_cap_aoe`, `defensive_margin`) as integral floats accepted and as non-integral floats rejected. A missing `ai_profiles.json` is CDB CR-1's `E_MISSING_FILE` — assert only that the validator does not invent defaults.
**Estimated test count**: ~11 unit tests

### RNG-002 RngService — Logic [S, merges first in W2]
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/rng_event_log/rng_service_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- Two services at `run_seed = 42`: 100 × `stream("run").randi_range(0, 65535)` sequences are identical, with `draws == 100` each.
- F2 stream seeds exactly: `run 60FB31FFA0FECE9A`, `match_1 8E28D71DC7508C82`, `match_2 3FC25FB4D7E5C7F5`, `draft_1 FFC74EA120AA040F`, `ai_1 89527D2C36D9A252`; seed 0 → `run 8AE616A7F56EA560` (pinned GDD examples; the literal is the point).
- F1 parsing:
  - `"42"` → `000000000000002A`, `"-1"` → `FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF`, `"deckdelve"` → `48A10CC0B2ED54EC`.
  - 16-hex input parses the same with or without `0x`.
  - Empty or whitespace input calls the injected `entropy` Callable exactly once; any other input never calls it.
  - `to_hex_u64(parse_hex_u64(h)) == h`, including a value above 2^53.
- Memoisation: `stream("match_3")` twice → same object, position intact. A bad name pushes an error and is still served. `fork("x")` → memoised `"<parent>/x"`, F3-seeded.
- The helper swap (`tests/helpers/test_rng_service.gd`, `test_rng_stream.gd`) keeps `tests/unit/framework/test_helpers_test.gd` green.

**Edge cases to cover** (rng-event-log Edge Cases → Seeds, Streams): same-label `fork` twice consumes one parent draw total; negative decimal seed display; a non-numeric string goes through FNV-1a.
**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests

  - It is `static` and never asserts.

**Edge cases to cover** (rng-event-log Edge Cases → Events, `max_match_events`): range boundaries exactly at 500,000 / 20,000,000 and 100 / 400 (accepted); one step outside each (rejected).
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### MR-004 Command channel, rejection codes and mulligan — Logic (tier full)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/match_rules/match_rules_command_channel_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-03: `mulligan([true, false, false])` → deck size unchanged, hand 3, card 0 the same instance, the returned instances somewhere in the deck, `mulligan_resolved` emitted. **Do not** assert "never redraws the same card" (DD-M05). All-`true` is a legal keep-all. A second `mulligan` → `WRONG_PHASE` (`MULLIGAN_ROUNDS` from config).
- AC-04: a 2-element mask → `accepted = false`, `code = INVALID_MASK`, and only `command_rejected` appended, with `diagnostic: true`, the code and the command, on the **same** log at the next `seq`.
- AC-37: a log subscriber calling `submit` during playback → `ENGINE_BUSY`, no state change, diagnostic `command_rejected`. The outer result stays `accepted = true` with a correct `[seq_first, seq_last]`.
- C2 phase/issuer guard: `play_card` in Mulligan → `WRONG_PHASE`; boss `mulligan` → `WRONG_PHASE`; right phase but wrong side → `NOT_YOUR_TURN`. The producible code set equals `MatchFactory.REJECTION_CODES` exactly (21, closed). `CommandResult` shape: `{accepted, rejection: {code, detail} | null, events: [seq_first, seq_last]}`.

**Edge cases to cover** (match-rules Edge Cases → Mulligan and setup, Win/loss): mask length follows the actual hand size after a hand-size hook (mask of 4 is valid when the player's hand is 4); a re-entrant `submit` from inside a rejection's own `command_rejected` event. `MATCH_ENDED` after `Ended` is story 008 — out of scope.
**Merge note**: if the implementation edits `MatchFactory`, the story becomes [S] (sprint plan).
**Estimated test count**: ~11 unit tests

### RNG-006 EventLog serialisation and diagnostics — Logic [W2; merges before RNG-007]
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/rng_event_log/event_log_serialization_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `to_json` → `from_json`: `replay_equal` holds. Header `{log_schema_version, engine_version, data_version, run_seed_hex, scope, floor, events[]}`. A `run_seed` above 2^53 survives bit-exactly as hex. `StringName` comes back as `String`. `seq`, `turn`, `cause_seq` and integral payload numbers come back as `int`. Floats are canonical with 6 decimals.
- `Vector2` payload in release: `to_json()` succeeds, the value reads `"<unserializable:Vector2>"` and `_coerced` lists the key (debug asserts; test the release path).
- Diagnostic `command_rejected`: takes the next `seq`, is returned by `events_since`, round-trips, counts in `size()`, and can be a `cause_seq`.
- F6: two logs from one scripted append sequence are byte-equal under `EventLogAssertions.canonical_json` and `to_json()`; a one-value difference breaks equality.

**Edge cases to cover** (rng-event-log Edge Cases → Events): other non-JSON types (`Color`, an Object, a Callable) coerce the same way; nested dict/array payloads round-trip; an empty log round-trips.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### CDB-004 Delegated validators and stage-7 lookups — Logic [S, merges first in W3]
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/card_database/card_database_validators_test.gd` (+ new `tests/helpers/validator_stubs.gd`)
**What to test**:
- A stub effects validator that rejects `op: "bogus"` → `E_DELEGATED` with the stub's code and the card id. The stub is called as `(host_kind, host_id, effects, db, configs)`, with `configs["card_effects"]` equal to the parsed body.
- No `ai_profile` validator registered → `E_DELEGATED` naming `ai_profile`, state `Failed`, the same in debug. A full stub map → no `E_DELEGATED`.
- `match_rules.json` with no `match_rules` validator → `E_DELEGATED` naming the file, state `Failed`. A config validator returning `[{code: "E_X"}]` → an `E_DELEGATED` entry carrying the owner's code and file. `card_database.json` needs no validator.
- Stage-7 lookups: `db.has`, `db.card` and `db.collectible_pool("war")` answer from the staged, id-sorted, stage-6-passed records, and the load reaches `Ready`. `db.config(...)` / `db.data_version()` during stage 7 return `null` / `""` with one logged error; the debug guard `_stage7_lookups_open` asserts.

**Edge cases to cover** (card-database Edge Cases → Versions and files, Runtime): a validator registered for a file not present (no crash; optional set absent); several delegated entries from one validator all reported (no fail-fast).
**Cross-epic note**: the sprint-1 MR-001 review found no `match_rules` config validator owner. Under CDB-004 the real load will go `E_DELEGATED` → `Failed` until one exists. Tests use `ValidatorStubs`, so they are unaffected, but `Boot.boot()` with real data is (see Risks).
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### MR-005 Turn structure, mana curve and turn cap — Logic (tier full) [S, merges second in W3]
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/match_rules/match_rules_turn_structure_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-05: the first Start step → `turn == 1`, `active_side == PLAYER`, mana `1/1`, hand 4. `match_started` precedes `turn_started`. C4 order: `turn_started`, `crystal_gained`, `mana_refilled`, `turn_reset` (one event with entity ids), [hooks/triggers], `card_drawn`, `phase_changed(Main)`.
- AC-06 (F4 `mana_max = min(turns_taken + crystal_bonus, MAX_MANA)`):
  - After 12 scripted turns per side, both sides read 10, and the formula held at every Start step.
  - `crystal_gained` fires only when `mana_max` rose; `mana_refilled` fires on every Start step.
  - With `crystal_bonus = 1` via an `on_match_start` hook, `mana_added{PLAYER, 1, temporary: false}` precedes the first `card_drawn`. The player reads 2/2 on turn 1 and 10/10 from turn 9; the boss is unchanged.
- AC-09: boss `play_card` in player Main → `NOT_YOUR_TURN`; player `mulligan` → `WRONG_PHASE`. `end_turn` order: `turn_ending`, `turn_end` triggers (player side, then boss, verified through `ctx.candidates` on the scripted resolver), `on_turn_end` hooks, thaw, `end_of_turn` enchantment removal, `turn_ended`, then the boss Start step with `active_side == BOSS`.
- AC-10: `TURN_CAP = 4` in the test config → at the 5th Start step, `phase == Ended`, `result.winner == BOSS`, `result.reason == turn_cap`, and `match_ended` is the last event.

**Edge cases to cover** (match-rules Formulas F4, Edge Cases → Hand/draw/fatigue): hand full at the Start-step draw → `card_burned`, the turn continues (only if the burn primitive is in scope; otherwise MR-006); `mana_max` exactly at the cap with a bonus (stays 10); a `TURN_CAP` read from config, not a literal.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### CDB-005 Budget warnings and pool thresholds — Logic [W3; rebases onto CDB-004]
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/card_database/card_database_budget_warnings_test.gd`
**What to test** (card-database Formulas: collectible pool, bundle pool, minimum treasure pool):
- 8 treasures, all `unlock: null` → `W_POOL_SIZE` 8 < 9 (`treasure_drafts_per_run` 3 × `treasure_offers_per_draft` 3), state `Ready`.
- `collectible_pool_size(hero_set) = n_nontoken(hero_set) + n_nontoken(neutral)` below `min_collectible_pool` → `W_POOL_SIZE` naming the set, found and threshold; state `Ready`.
- A bundle pool of 2 → `E_COUNT` (hard floor 3), `Failed`. A pool of 5 with `min_bundle_pool: 10` → `W_POOL_SIZE`, `Ready`.
- Empty `cards_decay.json` → `W_EMPTY_SET`, `Ready`, `cards_by_set("decay") == []`. A boss health off its band default → `W_BAND_HEALTH`. A shared `name` → `W_DUP_NAME` naming both ids.
- Knobs are read from config: a fixture with `min_collectible_pool: 99` over a 40-card pool → `W_POOL_SIZE`. `n_records > max_records` → `E_COUNT` naming `max_records`.

**Edge cases to cover**: the formula worked examples (MVP 25 + 15 = 40 ≥ 30, clean; bundle 8 + 2 = 10, clean); pool exactly at threshold (no warning); bundle pool exactly 3 (no `E_COUNT`); tokens excluded from `n_nontoken`.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

1. **Automated suite**: `godot --headless --path . --import`, then exactly `commands.test`. Exit 0, and no `No test cases found` in the output. Exit 101 (leaked nodes) counts as a failure, matching CI.

## Cross-cutting items

1. **G3 / G6 patterns are being corrected now.** A code-review fix pass is correcting both patterns while this plan is written. BOOT-005's AC transcribes ADR-0001 Decision 6, and the BOOT-004 and RNG-001 reviews found G3 and G6 wrong against the current tree. This plan **does not restate** either pattern.
   - BOOT-005's fixtures and real-tree assertion use the corrected patterns.
   - RNG-004's token list is settled against corrected G6, so the two scripts agree.
   - The sprint-close smoke runs the merged scripts as they stand.
   - `/story-readiness` on BOOT-005 should confirm the correction landed before `/dev-story` starts.
2. **BOOT-005 puts G1–G6 into CI.** After it merges, every later story merges against a blocking lint step. The sprint-close smoke **must** run `gates.sh` and `parse-check.sh` (Smoke item 2), not only read CI. The CI step needs ripgrep ≥ 14 on the runner.
3. **TASK-WINEXP evidence has two parts.** (a) A CI artifact: a green job that uploads `build/windows/deckdelve.exe`. (b) The owner's first-launch screenshot retained in `production/qa/evidence/windows-first-light-<date>/`. Neither replaces the other. The task has no story yet, so it is planned, not startable (sprint plan). If it starts after BOOT-005/RNG-004, it rebases onto their `tests.yml` edits.
4. **Perf-budget assertions need a separate, non-blocking CI job.** The testing standard forbids time-dependent assertions in the blocking suite, and `commands.test -a res://tests` runs everything under `tests/`.
   - No sprint-2 AC asserts a time. The guardrails named in Context (`submit()` ≤ 5 ms, 10,000 appends ≤ 50 ms, data load ≤ 200 ms, `validate_effects` ≤ 50 ms) belong to later stories (MR-018, RNG-010, CE-016, CDB-009).
   - Any developer who adds one this sprint puts it under `tests/performance/` with that separate job (thresholds reported, retries allowed), and keeps it out of the blocking job's `-a` paths.
   - **Existing violation**: `tests/integration/boot/boot_composition_test.gd` `test_boot_data_load_within_budget_ms` already asserts `elapsed_ms <= DATA_LOAD_BUDGET_MS` in the blocking suite. Its own comment calls it "advisory". The BOOT-004 review logged it as should-fix. It should become a printed observation or move to the perf job. It is not a sprint-2 story, so it is listed here and in Risks.
5. **Lane execution rule.** A lane may carry a dependency chain past a wave boundary (sprint plan). Each story still needs its own test file at the path above and a green full suite after its own commit. A chain's tests are never merged as one combined suite. Serialised stories ([S]) merge first in each wave, in the listed order.

## Risks to test coverage

| Risk | Effect on QA | Mitigation |
|------|--------------|------------|
| Helper swaps (RNG-002, RNG-005/007, MR-003, CDB-004) diverge from the doubles other suites use | Green story suite, red neighbour (sprint 1 `0448510`) | [S] merge order; full suite after every merge; Smoke item 6 |
| BOOT-005 lint step depends on `rg` ≥ 14 on `ubuntu-latest` | Lint step and `boot_lint_gates_test.gd` fail in CI only | Install ripgrep in the CI step; the script's exit 2 makes the cause visible |
| G3/G6 correction lands after BOOT-005 starts | Fixtures written against the old patterns | Readiness check on BOOT-005 (Cross-cutting 1) |
| No `match_rules` config validator owner (MR-001 review) | After CDB-004, a real-data `Boot.boot()` ends `Failed` on `E_DELEGATED` | Tests use `ValidatorStubs`. Owner decision needed before real data boots (BOOT-006's `main_menu` state needs a passing load: use the fixture override or flag it) |
| Existing wall-clock assertion in the blocking suite (BOOT-004) | Flaky BLOCKING test on a loaded runner | Cross-cutting 4 |
| RNG-004 "unit" suite does file I/O and spawns a subprocess | Breaks the unit-test isolation rule | Checked-in fixtures or move to `tests/integration/` (raise at readiness) |
| `sprint-status.yaml` shows BAI-002, CE-003, RNG-002, BAI-003, RNG-004, BOOT-006 as `backlog`, while their story files read `Status: Ready` | `/story-done` / `/sprint-status` report the wrong state | Reconcile via `/story-readiness` → `ready-for-dev` |
| Cross-epic doubles: CE-003 `CardFactory` db, BAI-002 stub config | Validators green against a double that drifts from `CardDatabase` | Re-run when CDB-006 lands (sprint 3) |

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories (15 this sprint, incl. stretch RNG-004)
- [ ] Retained screenshot of each screen touched, in `production/qa/evidence/`, for all Visual/Feel and UI stories — BOOT-006 (`main_menu`, `data_error`) if it lands
- [ ] Signed-off evidence doc for Visual/Feel stories — none this sprint
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off, after implementation), **including the lint gates** (Smoke item 2)
- [ ] No regressions introduced (`test_helpers_test.gd` and every sprint-1 suite green)
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review — the review lane per wave, recorded in Completion Notes "Reviewed by")
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
- [ ] TASK-WINEXP: CI artifact + `production/qa/evidence/windows-first-light-<date>/` screenshot, or recorded as carried with its story written
